premise: It's Starfish's birthday: Crab brings the music, Octopus the dancing, and little Shrimp, who brought nothing, is told she is the best present of all.
inspiration: The gift-giving folk tale (the poorest guest's gift) turned simple: being there is the gift.
lesson: Your friends want you, not your presents.

en-US.title: The Pool Party
en-US.text: [excited] It was {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish's birthday, and everyone came to the pool for a party! {starfish:face happy} {starfish:live jump} {crab:enter} Crab brought the music. {crab:face happy} {sfx:clicks} Click-clack, click-clack went his claws. {octopus:enter} Octopus brought the dancing. With eight arms, {octopus:face happy} {octopus:live dance} he could dance with EVERYONE at once! And {shrimp:enter} Shrimp brought… nothing at all. {shrimp:face sad} [nervously] I didn't bring a present, she whispered. [short pause] {starfish:live wave} Starfish waved all five arms. [warmly] You're here, said Starfish. That's the best present. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:spin} So Shrimp twirled, round and round, the twirliest dancer of all. {canvas:confetti 0.8 12s} [happily] Hooray! {crab:live dance} Crab clicked and danced. {octopus:live hug} Octopus hugged everyone at once. {starfish:sparkle} And Starfish had the happiest birthday a starfish ever had.

es-ES.title: La fiesta de la charca
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Era el cumpleaños de {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Estrella, y todos fueron a la charca para hacer una fiesta! {starfish:face happy} {starfish:live jump} {crab:enter} Cangrejo trajo la música. {crab:face happy} {sfx:clicks} Clic-clac, clic-clac, hacían sus pinzas. {octopus:enter} Pulpo trajo el baile. ¡Con ocho brazos {octopus:face happy} {octopus:live dance} podía bailar con TODOS a la vez! Y {shrimp:enter} Gamba trajo… nada. {shrimp:face sad} [nervously] No he traído regalo, susurró. [short pause] {starfish:live wave} Estrella movió sus cinco brazos. [warmly] Has venido, dijo Estrella. Ese es el mejor regalo. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:spin} Así que Gamba dio vueltas y más vueltas, la bailarina más giratoria de todas. {canvas:confetti 0.8 12s} [happily] ¡Hurra! {crab:live dance} Cangrejo chocó las pinzas y bailó. {octopus:live hug} Pulpo abrazó a todos a la vez. {starfish:sparkle} Y Estrella tuvo el cumpleaños más feliz que ha tenido nunca una estrella.
